description: This file defines the HL7InQueue class which models an HL7 message queue entry that has yet to be processed in the OpenMRS system. It includes constructors, getter/setter methods, and references to external classes and constants pertaining to HL7 message processing.

classes.name: HL7InQueue
classes.description: Represents an HL7 message entry waiting in the processing queue, including status, source information, and message data.

methods.name: HL7InQueue
methods.description: Convenience constructor to create a queue entry from a previously deleted archive entry.

methods.name: HL7InQueue
methods.description: Convenience constructor to create a queue entry from an errored entry.

methods.name: getHL7InQueueId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier for the queue entry.

methods.name: setHL7InQueueId
methods.description: Sets the unique identifier for the queue entry.

methods.name: getErrorMessage
methods.description: Retrieves the error message associated with this queue entry.

methods.name: setErrorMessage
methods.description: Sets the error message for this queue entry.

methods.name: getMessageState
methods.description: Returns the current state of the message, typically from HL7Constants.

methods.name: setMessageState
methods.description: Sets the current state of the message.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Implementation of OpenmrsObject.getId(); returns the HL7InQueueId.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Implementation of OpenmrsObject.setId(); sets the HL7InQueueId.
